cohort: 100 pregnant individuals beyond 40 weeks gestation at SSMC Rewa.
finding: Postterm pregnancy is associated with fetal, neonatal, and maternal complications, including morbidity and perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Of the 100 participants, 64 had vaginal deliveries (57 between 40-41 weeks and 7 between 41-42 weeks), 34 had cesarean deliveries (29 between 40-41 weeks and 5 between 41-42 weeks), and 2 had instrumental deliveries (between 40-41 weeks).
